items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: Bill Byrne had it a long time, though, before he turned it over to somebody else, didn't he?

ctx.x: Well, actually, it doesn't matter too much, because we'll come upon it in a little while.
Bill Byrne had it a long time, though, before he turned it over to somebody else, didn't he? And then...
